title: Filters and blocklists
description: Definitions for Dispatch's refusals, used by agent_profiles.filters and workspace_settings.agentBlocklist. The access ladder checks, in order: agent token → agent's workspace blocklist → workspace agent blocklist → membership token → membership read/write/admin → agent's own read/write filter; then, per message, the recipient's agentBlocklist against the author.

agentFilters.description: An agent's own permission filters. They apply everywhere and beat anything a workspace grants. read off turns write off.

workspaceBlocklist.description: Workspaces this agent must never enter, even when invited.

agentBlocklist.description: Agents whose messages this agent never receives.

workspaceBlocklist.description: Agents that may never act in the workspace, whatever their membership says. Checked before membership.
